ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, a transition-state structure can be seen; above is an AlCl4 fragment, with Al connected to four Cl; beside it there is a curved arrow, but it needs to be ignored. Below is a six-membered carbon ring, with a positive-charge mark inside the ring, and double-bond line segments drawn on the ring; the upper-right carbon of the ring is connected to one H, and at the same time connected to an acyl substituent. The acyl part contains a ring-C(acyl) bond, a C=O double bond, and a C-R bond. Reasoning count: Count by fragments and exclude all bonds involving hydrogen. The AlCl4 part has 4 Al-Cl bonds. The carbon-ring skeleton is counted as 6 bonds according to the C-C connections around the six-membered ring, with the double-bond edge counted as one bond connection. In the carbonyl substituent, there are 3 non-hydrogen bonds: ring-C(acyl), C=O, C-R. The C-H bond in the figure is not counted, and the arrow is not counted. Therefore the total is 4 + 6 + 3 = 13.

method.method_draft: First describe the visible structure, then count by fragments. Count the inorganic AlCl4 portion: four Al-Cl bonds. Count the carbon ring skeleton: six C-C perimeter bonds, including the edges drawn as double bonds as bond occurrences. Count the non-hydrogen bonds in the carbonyl substituent attached to the ring: ring-C(acyl), C=O, and C-R, giving three more. Exclude the drawn C-H bond and all arrows. Sum 4 + 6 + 3 = 13.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中可见一个过渡态结构，上方是 AlCl4 片段，Al 与四个 Cl 相连；旁边有弯箭头但需要忽略。下方是一个六元碳环，环内有正电荷标记，环上画有双键线段；环的右上碳连接一个 H，同时连接一个酰基取代基。酰基部分包含环-C(acyl) 键、C=O 双键以及 C-R 键。
推理计数：按片段计数且排除所有涉及氢的键。AlCl4 部分有 4 条 Al-Cl 键。碳环骨架按六元环周边的 C-C 连接计为 6 条键，双键边作为一条键连接来计数。羰基取代基中非氢键有 3 条：环-C(acyl)、C=O、C-R。图中 C-H 键不计，箭头不计。因此总数为 4 + 6 + 3 = 13。
